## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List checks run and their results. After code changes, run `npm run check`. For presentation changes, include build/validation results and identify any rendered slides you inspected. State missing tools or unresolved issues.

## Submission checks

- [ ] I reviewed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] This change contains no private projects, original confidential documents, credentials or unintended generated output.
- [ ] Any changed examples preserve fictional-data labels, provenance and stable slide IDs as applicable.
